title: Cassie Plushie Totem
description: Turns totems into super kawaii Cassie plushie >w<
body:
This resource pack changes the texture of the Totem of Undying to resemble the Makeship Cassie plushie.

Even though it says it only works on 1.21.7-1.21.8, it should work with most versions of Minecraft.

I did NOT create this character, she is 100% owned by Sad Panda Studios (no lawsuit plzy)
